errors.text: The proposed HIP intervention does not reconstruct the chemical-short-range-order intervention and its HfTi/TiZr percolative structures.
The predicted decrease is opposite to the target result: short-range order increases lattice thermal conductivity by approximately 12%.
The cited studies establish HIP-induced phase changes and mechanical properties, not a reduction in lattice thermal conductivity.
Laser-flash measurement of total thermal conductivity alone cannot separate lattice-mediated and electronic heat transport, as explicitly required.

HIP is asserted to introduce phonon-scattering defects without evidence or defect quantification; it can also remove porosity and alter density, grain structure, and phase constitution, creating competing conductivity effects.
